name: My Tho Cathedral
nameVi: Nhà thờ chính tòa Mỹ Tho
summary: Town cathedral at 32 Hùng Vương: sit in the nave for a morning or late-afternoon mass. Sunday mass is at 05:15, 07:30, 16:30, and 18:30. On other days it is at 05:15 and 17:45. The clock tower and the cross mark the front. Older addresses still name Phường 7.
heroCaption: The cathedral front, clock tower and cross against a clear sky

notice.title: Go for a mass
notice.body: Go for a mass. Sunday is 05:15, 07:30, 16:30, and 18:30. Other days are 05:15 and 17:45.

body: The cathedral stands at 32 Hùng Vương. The front is the clock tower, the cross, and the arched door. Step into the nave for the mass. Sunday is 05:15, 07:30, 16:30, and 18:30. On other days the masses are 05:15 and 17:45.

Older addresses still name Phường 7. Use 32 Hùng Vương. Electric-cart route 1 names Vincom Plaza Mỹ Tho on Hùng Vương and runs 07:00–22:00 at 40,000 VND a guest. The cathedral is the church at number 32 on that street.

figures.caption: The nave, looking toward the altar
figures.alt: The nave of My Tho Cathedral, pews leading to the altar and crucifix

gettingThere: The cathedral is at 32 Hùng Vương. Older addresses place it in Phường 7. Route 1 of the electric cart, from số 01 Hoàng Sa, names Vincom Plaza Mỹ Tho on the same street and runs 07:00–22:00 at 40,000 VND a guest.

legs.heading: From the pier at 01 Hoàng Sa
legs.body: Electric-cart route 1 runs to Hùng Vương, 07:00–22:00, at 40,000 VND a guest. The named mall stop on that street is Vincom. The cathedral is 32 Hùng Vương.

legs.heading: From a room on đường 30 Tháng 4
legs.body: The same cart from the pier, or a ride to 32 Hùng Vương. The embankment and the church are both in town.

hours: Sunday mass 05:15, 07:30, 16:30, and 18:30. Other days 05:15 and 17:45.
